1.20.1.1.0.1.0: Clan ranks: the leader can create up to 10 ranks (name, colour, order), each with its own management rights (invite, kick, claim/unclaim/force-load, settlement permissions, vault, alliances/war, assigning ranks) and its own rights on the clan's land (build, doors, containers, animals, farming, trading). Members can only kick or re-rank members below them. New Ranks tab; vault access is now a rank right. Old worlds load without losing anything: Officer and Member become two default ranks with the same rights. The clan tag now shows next to player names in the clan colour (tab list, name tag, chat). /teammsg and /tm go to clan chat. Founding a settlement too close to another clan or over the chunk limit now says so right away instead of first asking for a name. Very dark clan colours (like black) get a white border on the map so the claim stays visible. Server and client must run the same version. Closed several ways around claim protection: pistons can no longer push or pull blocks into or out of another clan's land, lava can no longer make stone or start fires across a claim border, and arrows and other projectiles, sweeping attacks, thorns and splash potions from players no longer hurt protected animals, item frames, paintings or armor stands. Clan actions are rate-limited per player and only resync clients when something actually changed. The clan and claim buttons on the world map match DV Map 1.0.1.0's larger toolbar.
